column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_duel_eng.prx (runtime base 0x09be1400); same columns as re/documented.tsv.

column3: summary

Picks one of the four effect tables from the selector bits of ctx, binary-searches it on the card id, walks back to the first duplicate and adds the variant index; returns the 24-byte record or 0. No side effects.
Resolves an effect: calls the record's slot +04 handler with (ctx, arg); card 0x1975 is special-cased. Returns the handler's result or 0. Side effects: those of the handler.
Slot +04 handler shared by 44 cards: the controller draws duel_effects_get_draw_count(ctx) cards (a negative count or card 0x12da makes the opponent draw). Returns 0. Side effects: hand and deck.
Slot +0c handler shared by 17 cards: 0 when the draw count is 0, else duel_core_can_draw(controller, count). No side effects.
Per-card draw count: a compare chain on the card id (Pot of Greed 0x12ec gives 2), some counts computed from game state (e.g. 5 minus hand size), negative values mean the opponent. No side effects.
True when player (the opponent for a negative count) may draw |count| cards: no draw-preventing card (0x178b, 0x1885) applies and the deck holds at least |count| cards. No side effects.
Draws count cards for player via duel_core_draw_cards_ex(player, count, 1, 0); 47 callers. Side effects: hand and deck.

column2: int duel_effects_target_filter(void *ctx, int player, int index, uint flags)
column3: Returns whether field slot index (0-4 monster, 5-9 spell/trap, 10 field) of player passes the flags: side (bits 0-1), occupied/empty (0x4/0x8), slot +0x06 zero/non-zero (0x80/0x100), zone class (0x70) and further bits. Reached from 410 per-card stubs that load flags into a3 (bits decoded in effect-tables.md). No side effects.
Returns the current phase 0x09e2d1e8 (0 Draw, 1 Standby, 2 Main 1, 3 Battle, 4 Main 2, 5 End, 7 none). No side effects.
Returns 1 when the phase 0x09e2d1e8 is 2 (Main 1) or 4 (Main 2), else 0. No side effects.

Stores phase in 0x09e2d1e8 without animation and positions the turn step 0x09e2d210/sub-step 0x09e2d214 to match (phase 3 also sets the Battle step 0x09e2d220 to 1). Callers: the .ydq parser 0x09dc82cc and command 0x1a 0x09db3f40.

Body of engine commands 10-15. First call: UI event 5 (side, phase), stores the phase, runs the phase-change card hooks 0x09be6d90/0x09be71b4/0x09be6ac4; later calls: when the banner is done, 0x09be75f8, UI event 0x26 and the command completes (0x09e29904 = 0).

column2: int duel_core_post_ui_event(int event, int a, int b, int c)
column3: Stores the four arguments at 0x09e01e14..0x09e01e20 and calls the presentation hook at 0x09e01e10; returns 1. Over 100 callers (command handlers).
Returns duel_core_can_conduct_battle(side) when the phase is below 4 (not yet Main Phase 2), else 0. No side effects.
Activation condition: true when the turn side 0x09e2d1d8 differs from the owner bit of ctx+2 and the phase is 1 (Standby). No side effects; reached through the handler tables.

Returns the cached battle-dominance value of side (-4..4, from ai_eval_battle_dominance) at 0x09e28008 + side * 0x30c, or recomputes it when flag 0x09e03070 & 0x20 is set. No side effects. 129 callers.
Number of entries of one of the AI (card id, handler) priority tables; some lengths depend on state (0x09e03078, the battle dominance, the phase). No side effects.

column2: void * ai_table_entry(int side, void * table, int index)
column3: Returns entry index of an AI priority table, prepending the filtered opening table 0x09dfe500 to 0x09dfe848 and the chain table 0x09dfd448 to 0x09e00480; 0 for filtered entries. No side effects.

column2: int ai_pick_monster_by_stats(int side, uint slot_mask, int atk_sign, int def_sign)
column3: Shuffles the monster slots of side in slot_mask and returns the one with the highest (sign > 0) or lowest (sign < 0) ATK and/or DEF, +1 for monsters able to attack; -1 if none. Side effect: advances the duel RNG.

column2: int ai_pick_slot_by_score(int side, uint slot_mask, void * score_fn)
column3: Shuffles the slots 0-10 of side in slot_mask and returns the one with the highest positive score_fn(side, slot); -1 if none. Side effect: advances the duel RNG.

column2: void ai_push_context(int side, int view_side, int replan)
column3: Pushes (side, view, replan) on the AI context stack at 0x09e03028 (depth 0x09e03026), sets the AI side 0x09e02ff8 and view 0x09e02ffa, rebuilds the board view when they change and re-plans when replan is set. 28 callers (AI entry wrappers).
Linear congruential RNG: seed 0x09e2d1cc = seed * 0x343fd + 0x269ec3; returns n * ((seed & 0x7fffffff) >> 16) >> 15, in [0, n). Side effect: updates the seed. 100 callers.
AI table handler that always accepts (returns 1). No side effects; referenced only from the AI priority tables.
AI table handler that always refuses (returns 0). No side effects.

column2: int ai_chain_table_length(int side, void * table, int flag)
column3: Length of the chain-response AI tables: 345 for 0x09dfd448; 2 for 0x09dfdf10 and 181 for 0x09dfdf20 when flag != 0, else 0; 0 for any other table. No side effects.

Pays a Life Point cost: amount 0 is ignored, otherwise clamped to 0xffff and posted as engine command 0x24 (LP loss) with reason 2. No other side effects. 28 callers (Battle step 3 declaration costs, Standby/End Phase upkeep, effect handlers).
Life Point loss that is not a cost or damage (Jirai Gumo halves LP): posts command 0x24 with reason 3; amount 0 ignored, clamped to 0xffff. Callers: 0x09dd3574, 0x09c7c9a4.

column2: int duel_core_gain_lp(void *ctx, int player, int amount)
column3: Life Point gain from the effect context ctx. If the other side has Bad Reaction to Simochi or Nurse Reficule (and no Prime Material Dragon) the gain becomes damage via duel_core_inflict_damage and 0 is returned. Otherwise posts command 0x23 (reason 4), raises timing event 0x11 and checks Fire Princess; returns 1. Returns 0 for amount 0. 19 callers (effect handlers, duel_core_inflict_damage).

column2: int duel_core_inflict_damage(void *ctx, int player, int amount)
column3: Effect damage to player from the effect context ctx: applies Energy-Absorbing Monolith, Ring of Defense, Trap of Board Eraser, Barrel Behind the Door, Spell of Pain, Rainbow Life and Prime Material Dragon replacements and the prevention check 0x09c0d6ac, then posts command 0x24 (reason 0, source card), registers damage triggers and raises timing event 0x10. Returns 1 when damage was posted, else 0. 69 callers.

column2: void duel_core_inflict_card_damage(int player, int amount, int flip, int card)
column3: Builds a zeroed 24-byte effect context for card (controller bit = player ^ flip, presentation flags for non-monster cards) and calls duel_core_inflict_damage. 13 callers (Battle step 7, chain resolver, End Phase upkeep).

Applies one battle-damage record (amount, source side, source slot, damaged player, damaged slot): Power Wall reduction, command 0x24 reason 1 with the source monster's card id, trigger registration for 'when battle damage is inflicted' cards, timing event 0x0f. Returns nothing; amount 0 does nothing. Caller: Battle step 7 (0x09dd7528).

Handler of engine command 0x23; jumps to the shared body 0x09dbffd8 with a0 = 1: animates (UI events 0x10, 0x4d), then LP += a unless LP is 0, updates statistics, posts UI event 9 and finishes the command. Caller: duel_core_execute_command.

Handler of engine command 0x24; shared body 0x09dbffd8 with a0 = 0: LP = max(LP - a, 0); stores a special-victory card id in the winner's block +0x2c when a direct attack by such a card is lethal; statistics; UI events 0x10, 0x4d, 9. Caller: duel_core_execute_command.
Handler of engine command 0x25: UI event 0x0f, then sets the side's LP to argument a, statistics, UI event 9. Caller: duel_core_execute_command.

column2: void duel_core_battle_add_damage(unsigned int *src, unsigned int *dst, int amount)
column3: Writes the next free battle-damage record at 0x09e286e0 (amount, src side/slot, dst side/slot or the opponent and slot 5 when dst is NULL); flips the damaged player for Magical Reflect Slime, Amazoness Swords Woman, Metal Fiend Token and Dimension Wall. Caller: duel_core_battle_resolve.
Calls duel_core_battle_compute_stats(apply, 0). Callers: Battle steps 5 and 6, commands 0x15 and 0x16, 0x09cb8294.
Calls duel_core_battle_resolve(apply, 0). Callers: Battle step 6, commands 0x15 and 0x16, 0x09cb8294.
Stores the attacker's card instance and generation and those of the defender's five Monster Zones (12 words) into out. No other side effects. Caller: duel_core_cmd_declare_attack.

Returns how many of the opponent's five Monster Zones are valid targets for the monster at (side, slot) according to duel_core_is_valid_attack_target(mode 1). No side effects. Callers: Battle step 2, 0x09c63b2c.

Opens a timing-event batch: increments 0x09e28f90 and, at depth 0, clears the queue count 0x09e28f98 and the pending flag 0x09e29048 and increments the serial 0x09e28f94; in a link duel forwards it to the peer. About 200 callers.
Closes a timing-event batch (decrements 0x09e28f90; link duels forward it). About 200 callers.

Queues a timing event: outside a batch restarts the queue with it (code 0 just clears it), inside a batch appends it (max 32) at 0x09e28fa0/0x09e28fc0; sets the window-pending flag 0x09e29048 and resets the window state. Ignored while the chain resolves (0x09e28f9c); forwarded to the peer in link duels. 41 callers.

Response-window state machine run while 0x09e29048 is set: checks the end of the duel, skips the turn player when the first event is 0x17, 0x04 or 0x03, offers a window to the turn player then to the opponent (duel_core_offer_response_window); clears 0x09e29048 when a card was activated or both passed. Always returns 1. Callers: 0x09c32dac, 0x09c32e54.
Requests the processing of monsters destroyed by battle: 0x09e2d2bc = 4, 0x09e2d298 = 1, handled by the pending-work function 0x09c232bc. Caller: Battle step 9.
Handler of command 0x1d: Battle step index = 11, UI events 0x0e and 0x26, command finished. Caller: duel_core_execute_command.
Handler of command 0x14: Battle step index = 1, refreshes continuous effects (0x09be71b4), UI events 10 and 0x26, command finished. Caller: duel_core_execute_command.
Handler of command 0x20: sets flag bit 2 of slot a of the command's side and, when the battle record's destruction mode is positive, bit 6 of slot byte +0x36. Caller: duel_core_execute_command.

Returns the reason side has won (0 none, 1 opponent LP 0, 2 opponent +0x24 flag, 3 Exodia, 4 Destiny Board, 6 Last Turn, 7 Final Countdown, 8 special-victory card, 9 Vennominaga, 10 Exodius, 11 turn limit with fewer LP). Side effect: Last Turn sets 0x09e2d1d4. Caller: duel_core_check_duel_end.

Calls duel_core_check_win for both sides; when either won stores each reason in block +0x30, sets the result 0x09e2d1f0 (1 local, 2 opponent, 3 draw) and the latch 0x09e2d1d4, returns 1; otherwise 0. Skipped for the remote side of a link duel. Callers: duel_core_run_turn_flow, duel_core_chain_step, 0x09c2e244, duel_core_run_timing_windows.

column2: unsigned int duel_core_get_card_action_mask(int side, int location, int index)
column3: Returns the bit mask of player actions allowed for the card at (side, location, index) in the current input mode 0x09e2d24c; bit n = action code n. No side effects except the refusal reason in 0x09e2d288. No callers in the module (reached from rel_duel_draw).

column2: void duel_core_submit_player_action(int side, int location, int index, int code)
column3: Stores a player's answer (code 0x09e2d26c, side, location, index, card id and reference) and leaves input mode; in zone-selection mode only stores the zone in 0x09e2d284. Callers: AI main-phase code, duel_core_begin_player_input, the tutorial.

Pending-work function polled by duel_core_run_turn_flow: when an answer is ready, runs the action for code 0x09e2d26c (summon, set, flip, position change, activate, view list). Returns 1 while busy. Caller: duel_core_run_turn_flow.
Returns 1 when an answer is ready and its code is 0x0b (card or zone picked). No side effects. About 130 callers (selection loops).

column2: unsigned int duel_core_get_summon_set_mask_ex(int side, int ref, int mode, int tributes)
column3: Returns 0x10 if the hand card with reference ref may be Normal Summoned and 0x40 if it may be Set: card locks, LP costs, card-specific rules, then tributes = (level>=5)+(level>=7) against free zones and duel_core_count_tribute_value. Side effect: refusal reason 0x09e2d288. 24 callers (UI, AI, summon preparation).
True while bit 17 of player word +0x120 is clear, or while Double Summon or Chain Summoning still grants an extra Normal Summon. No side effects. 20 callers.
Sets bit 17 of player word +0x120 (Normal Summon used); if already set, marks the Double Summon or Chain Summoning entry as used. Callers: commands 0x50, 0x51, 0x2b.

Returns 1 if the monster in slot may change battle position: slot flag bit 21 clear (not arrived, attacked or changed this turn), no card lock, duel mode not 8. Side effect: refusal reason 3 or 0x12. Callers: action mask, flip check, AI.
Returns 1 if the face-down monster in slot may be Flip Summoned (position change allowed, flip summons allowed, card-specific conditions, summon locks). No side effects. 12 callers.

column2: int duel_core_begin_summon_from_hand(int mode, int special, int normal_flag)
column3: Starts a summon of the card in the current answer: calls duel_core_init_summon_from_hand(side, ref, special ? 2 : mode, normal_flag) and clears the answer. Returns 1. Callers: duel_core_execute_player_action, AI summon code, effects granting a summon.

column2: void duel_core_init_summon_from_hand(int side, int ref, int mode, int normal_flag)
column3: Fills the summon record 0x09e290bc for a summon from the hand (mode 1 Normal Summon, 0 Set, 2 Special Summon by procedure; normal_flag>=1 uses the Normal Summon, normal_flag-1 preselected tributes) and marks it pending. Caller: duel_core_begin_summon_from_hand.

column2: void duel_core_special_summon_impl(int side, void *entry, int face_up, int position, unsigned int flags)
column3: Fills the summon record for a Special Summon by an effect (kind 4) from the list entry or slot entry; Light of Intervention forces face-up; flags>>16 is the summoning card. Caller: duel_core_special_summon.

column2: void duel_core_special_summon(int side, void *entry, int face_up, int position, unsigned int flags)
column3: Wrapper of duel_core_special_summon_impl used by 67 effect handlers (Polymerization, revival effects, ...). Side effects: the summon record.

Pending-work state machine of the summon record: preparation (tributes or materials) through duel_core_summon_prepare, then the kind-specific executor (normal, flip, gemini, special, procedure). Returns 1 while busy. Caller: duel_core_run_turn_flow.

Generic tribute selection for the pending summon: computes the tributes needed, lets the player pick them (mode 8) or accepts the AI's choice, stores them in the record. Returns 1 done, 0 continue, -1 cancelled. Caller: duel_core_summon_prepare and card-specific preparations.

column2: int duel_core_change_position(int side, int slot, int flip, int a4, int by_effect, int a6)
column3: Changes a monster's battle position (and turns it face-up when flip): checks, posts command 0x33, marks bit 21 for a manual change, runs FLIP effects and raises timing event 9 or 0x0b. Returns 1 on success. 9 callers.

column2: void duel_core_place_spell_trap_from_hand(int side, int index, int zone, int face_up)
column3: Posts command 0x51 placing hand card index into spell/trap zone (face-up to activate, face-down to set) and raises timing event 0x0a when set. Callers: duel_core_action_place_spell_trap, 0x09c84fdc.

column2: void * duel_core_get_location_entry(int side, int location, int index)
column3: Returns the address of the 4-byte list entry (hand 0x0b, extra 0x0c, deck 0x0d, graveyard 0x0e, banished 0x0f) or the 20-byte field slot (location+index <= 10). No side effects. 40 callers.

Finds the card with instance reference ref on the field, in the graveyards, banished zones, decks, extra decks and hands; returns side | location<<8 | index<<16, or 0x1000. No side effects. 100 callers.

column2: void duel_core_zone_remove(int side, int location, int index)
column3: Removes a card from a list or field slot (per-list removers; for slots clears lingering effects and the slot). Callers: the movement command handlers.

column2: void duel_core_zone_insert(int side, int location, unsigned int pos, void *entry)
column3: Inserts a card entry into a list (deck top/bottom by pos) or a field slot (monster zones with position and face from pos). Callers: the movement command handlers.

column2: int duel_core_send_hand_card(int side, void *entry, unsigned int flags, int dest, int discard, int reason)
column3: Sends a hand card to the graveyard or banished zone (redirected by banish-instead rules) by posting command 0x3e/0x32/0x45; raises the matching timing event and per-card hooks. Returns the final destination. Callers: wrappers 0x09c18d70..0x09c18fe4.

column2: void duel_core_compute_card_stats(int side, int slot, unsigned int *out, unsigned int flags, int timestamp)
column3: Fills the 13-word stat block of monster slot side/slot (name id, effective id, Type, Attribute, mask, Level, ATK, DEF, original ATK/DEF, immunity masks): original stats, the card's own continuous effect, other face-up cards and the field spell in timestamp order, attached records, equips, then Reverse Trap sign, Avatar/Cyber Blader/Water Dragon/Mirror Wall/Dreadroot, clamp at 0 unless flags bit 0. flags bit 1 ignores kind 1/2 records. No side effects. Callers: duel_core_get_card_stats, the ATK/DEF getters, duel_core_battle_compute_stats, the AI stat views.

column2: void duel_core_get_card_stats(int side, int slot, unsigned int *out)
column3: duel_core_compute_card_stats(side, slot, out, 0, 0). About 75 callers (effect handlers, AI, field send code).

column2: void duel_core_compute_base_stats(int side, int slot, unsigned int *out, unsigned int flags)
column3: Words 0/1 and 8-12 of the stat block: card-data ATK/DEF, name and effective id, immunity masks, trap-monster stats, the card's own original-stat rules and original-stat records (Unstable Evolution, Zero Sprite, Alchemy Cycle, ATK/DEF swaps). No side effects. Callers: compute_card_stats, the original-stat getters.

column2: void duel_core_get_base_stats(int side, int slot, unsigned int *out)
column3: duel_core_compute_base_stats(side, slot, out, 0).
Current ATK (stat-block word 6, clamped at 0). Callers: target rules, effect handlers, AI.
Current DEF (stat-block word 7, clamped at 0). Callers: effect handlers, AI.
Original ATK (word 8 of compute_base_stats). Callers: duel_core_battle_resolve, effect handlers, AI.
Original DEF (word 9 of compute_base_stats).

column2: int duel_effects_get_field_card_stat_bonus(unsigned int *stats, int src_side, int src_slot, int side, int slot, int *atk, int *def)
column3: ATK/DEF bonus that the face-up card at src_side/src_slot (monster or spell/trap zone) gives the monster described by stats at side/slot: chain on the source card id gated by the immunity words. Returns non-zero when either amount is non-zero. No side effects. Callers: compute_card_stats, 0x09c09e00.

column2: int duel_effects_get_field_spell_stat_bonus(unsigned int *stats, int src_side, int src_slot, int side, int slot, int *atk, int *def)
column3: Same for the field-spell zone card: Forest..Yami by Type, the Attribute fields, Neo Space, Necrovalley and others. No side effects. Callers: compute_card_stats, 0x09c09e00.

Writes Type, Attribute, Level, ATK and DEF of six trap/spell monsters (Cyber Shadow Gardna, Stronghold, Zoma, Metal Reflect Slime, Embodiment of Apophis, The Rival's Name) into a stat block. Callers: compute_base_stats, the race/attribute/level getters.

column2: int duel_core_attach_effect(int side, int slot, int kind, int key, int value)
column3: Takes the first free 10-byte record of the pool 0x09e2c7cc (1..255), appends it to the slot's list (slot +0x0a) with kind (bits 0-3, turn counter bits 4-7), key, value and timestamp 0x09e2d1d0. Returns the index or -1. Callers: command 0x35 and other command handlers, effect handlers, AI simulation.

column2: int duel_core_attach_instance_effect(int instance, int kind, int key, int value)
column3: Same as duel_core_attach_effect on the list of card instance `instance` (0x09e2bbcc + 6 * instance + 4). Callers: command 0x35 (instance form), 0x09d11480, 0x09dbe418, 0x09dbe814.
Clears pool record `index` and replaces it with its successor in every slot list and instance list that points to it. Callers: expiry, detach helpers, effect handlers.
Frees every record of a list. Callers: 0x09bef07c, duel_core_zone_remove.
Frees every kind >= 6 record on the field whose key is side | slot << 8 (the source card left). Caller: duel_core_zone_remove.

column2: int duel_core_slot_has_effect(int side, int slot, int key)
column3: 1 when the slot's list holds a kind <= 5 record with that key. No side effects. More than 250 callers.

column2: int duel_core_sum_effect_values(int side, int slot, int key)
column3: Sum of the values of the slot's kind < 6 records with that key. Callers: duel_core_battle_compute_stats, 0x09beff3c, 0x09c74cbc, 0x09db7620.

column2: int duel_core_count_links(int side, int slot, int head, int card, int check_active, int check_immunity, int kind, int timestamp)
column3: Counts the list's link records (kinds 6-11, or exactly `kind`) whose source location currently holds `card`, optionally only active sources the monster is not immune to and only within a timestamp bound. Callers: wrappers 0x09be7c28, 0x09be7d00, 0x09be7d48 and others.

column2: int duel_core_is_active_card_at(int side, int slot, int card)
column3: 1 when the slot holds `card` (effective id), its effect is active and the slot is not disabled in 0x09e2bba8. Over 70 callers.

Walks the 255 pool records at the turn change: kind 1/2 records are freed when their turn counter is 0 or decremented; links of All-Out Attacks, Swift Samurai Storm!, Attribute Chameleon and an expired Weapon Change are freed. Caller: command handler 0x09dbc584.
